description: Four small bowls sit on the green bedspread in front of you: a mint-green bowl, a dark teal bowl, an orange bowl, and a light purple bowl. The left hand slides the mint-green bowl rightward onto the dark teal bowl while the right hand steadies the teal bowl, then the right hand lifts the orange bowl and places it on top; next the left hand picks up the light purple bowl and sets it as the top bowl, and both hands release, leaving a neat stack.
